name: tabs
need: Switch between the sections of one page or record: line or contained, across or down, with counts, icons and tabs that close

--ds-tabs-height.description: a tab at size md and comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step; the state layer is a pill `--ds-space-1` inside it; a contained tab gives up the tray's padding)

--ds-tabs-padding-x.description: a tab's side padding at size md (4px per size step)

--ds-tabs-font.description: the type of a tab (always at the regular weight; the selected tab takes the label weight)

--ds-tabs-indicator-height.description: the bar of the selected tab, under it (at its end in a vertical row)

--ds-tabs-indicator-color.description: the bar of the selected tab, under it (at its end in a vertical row)

physical..ds-tabs--vertical:not(.ds-tabs--contain: the bar at the end of a vertical row: a background position has no logical form, and the system does not mirror (D4)
